comment: she is so disorganized. no test link but expect us to take a test. what can i say

Dr. Peifer is one of the most compassionate professors I've ever had. She will work hard with you to improve. There are pre-class readings, and sometimes she leaves things unexplained in the lectures that will pop up on the test, so make sure to take great notes

Unfortunately, everything was made political. You are essentially graded on parroting her beliefs. Religion was spoken about negatively multiple times. Sadly the tests were extremely unfair, with zero clarity on content. She incorrectly graded exams and gave us significantly worse grades, since then she had to re-grade everyone's exams.

Take Psychopathology with Dr. Peifer if you are interested in the subject! A lot of what we learned was from the textbook instead of lecture but she does briefly go over everything from the readings. She handles sensitive topics well. There is a LOT of reading but you could get away with skimming most of it. 
Not very accessible outside of class.

Genuinely such a kind and knowledgeable professor. Had us over to her house a few times. I learned a lot without it being a heavy or difficult class. Talked about difficult topics with sensitivity and grace. Definitely reccomend for an FYS if you're interested in psychology, but even if you aren't you will have no trouble in this class. Love her!

Dr Peifer was a very personable teacher who even held class at her own home twice.  She looked out for her students' mental health. The class was interesting and we learned without it being too difficult.
